description: Utilidad para descifrar de forma segura textos cifrados con RSA (OAEP-SHA256) a partir de una clave privada en formato PEM, con validación de Base64 y tamaño de bloque sin lanzar excepciones.

Player and admin access for NextLevel services, behind one AddAccess call. Replaces NextLevel.Auth and NextLevel.Admin.Auth: JWT validation, claim helpers, token refresh, the ban gate over NextLevel.Communicator, admin permissions, the tenant endpoint guard and audit forwarding.
A .NET standard library for positional astronomy: astronomical time scales, sidereal time, sun position, sunrise, sunset and twilight
A dependency-free .NET standard library to read ESRI File Geodatabases (*.gdb folders)
A .NET standard library for satellite orbits: TLE and OMM reading, SGP4 propagation and the satellite's position over the Earth
EF Core PostgreSQL/PostGIS support for IRI.Maptor Geometry<Point>: maps geometry/geography columns via EWKB with an Npgsql type plugin and an EF Core provider plugin, replacing NetTopologySuite.
